rules.expr: _time:2m {application="host",environment="host",service="dragontools-host"} type:="dragontools_host" event:="host_reboot_required" | stats by (host, event_id) count() as events | filter events:>0

annotations.kernel: {{ $rows := query (printf "_time:5m {application=\"host\",environment=\"host\",service=\"dragontools-host\"} type:=\"dragontools_host\" host:=%q event_id:=%q | stats by (kernel) count() as hits | filter hits:>0" $labels.host $labels.event_id) }}{{ if gt (len $rows) 0 }}{{ label "kernel" (index $rows 0) }}{{ end }}
